2026-07-14.content: * **(Cloud Storage)** Updated `gcloud storage rsync` to default decompresses downloaded gzip files to match the behavior of `gcloud storage cp`. To retain the previous behavior, use the new `--do-not-decompress` flag.

summary.title: Cloud Storage rsync decompression behavior change
summary.summary: The `gcloud storage rsync` command now defaults to decompressing downloaded gzip files. This change aligns its behavior with `gcloud storage cp`. To keep the old behavior, use the new `--do-not-decompress` flag.

2026-07-14.content: * Updated Linux bundled Python for the `gcloud` CLI to 3.14.6 to resolve CVE-2026-34182.

summary.title: Gcloud CLI Python Update
summary.summary: The gcloud CLI has been updated to Python 3.14.6 to address a security vulnerability (CVE-2026-34182). This update ensures the continued security and stability of the command-line interface.

2026-07-14.content:
* Fixed a performance regression in `gcloud artifacts docker images list` when
  listing a large number of image versions.

summary.title: Artifact Registry performance improvements
summary.summary: We've resolved a performance issue in the Artifact Registry where listing a large number of Docker image versions could be slow. This update ensures a smoother experience when managing your container images.

2026-07-14.content:
* Promoted `gcloud biglake delta-sharing <catalogs|shares|schemas|tables>` to GA.
* Promoted `gcloud biglake data-product-sharing publish` to GA.
* Added `lakehouse` option to `--catalog=type` flag to `gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs`.
* Added `gcloud biglake hive tables update` to beta.

summary.title: BigLake GA and New Features
summary.summary: BigLake announces the General Availability of its Delta Sharing and Data Product Sharing capabilities. New features include the 'lakehouse' option for Iceberg catalogs and the beta release of Hive table updates.

2026-07-14.content:
* Added environment information to the user-agent HTTP header.
* Added support for `--label` flag in `bq cp`, `bq extract`, and `bq load` commands to configure job-level labels.
* Fixed 'bq show' command failures displaying timestamps without fractional seconds.

summary.title: BigQuery command-line tool improvements
summary.summary: The BigQuery command-line tool has been updated with enhanced environment information in the user-agent header. New support for job-level labels has been added to `bq cp`, `bq extract`, and `bq load` commands, along with a fix for `bq show` command failures related to timestamp formatting.

2026-07-14.content:
* Added `gcloud datalineage runs` command group to manage data lineage runs.
* Added `gcloud datalineage lineage-events` command group to manage data lineage runs.

summary.title: Manage Data Lineage Runs
summary.summary: Introducing new gcloud commands to manage data lineage runs and lineage events. This enhancement allows for better control and organization of your data lineage information.

2026-07-14.content:
* Added `--enable-catalog-publishing` flag to `gcloud dataplex datascans create data-documentation` and `gcloud dataplex datascans update data-documentation` commands.
* Added `--mode` flag to `gcloud dataplex datascans create data-profile` and `gcloud dataplex datascans update data-profile` commands to support specifying profiling mode.

summary.title: Dataplex data scanning enhancements
summary.summary: New flags for Dataplex data scans allow enabling catalog publishing and specifying profiling modes. These updates improve data documentation and profiling capabilities within Dataplex.

2026-07-14.content: * Promoted `gcloud dataproc batches submit pyspark-notebook` to GA.

summary.title: Dataproc Notebooks Now Generally Available
summary.summary: Cloud Dataproc is pleased to announce that the `gcloud dataproc batches submit pyspark-notebook` command is now generally available. This feature allows users to easily submit PySpark notebooks for execution on Dataproc clusters. This marks a significant step in simplifying notebook-based data processing workflows.

2026-07-14.content: * Promoted support for `agent-registry` resource type in `gcloud iap web` IAM commands to GA.

summary.title: IAP support for Agent Registry promoted to GA
summary.summary: Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy now fully supports the agent-registry resource type for IAM commands. This promotion to General Availability enhances security for managing access to your agent registry resources.

2026-07-14.content:
* (Alpha, Beta) Added `--folder` flag to
  `gcloud kms autokey-config show-effective-config` to retrieve the effective
  Cloud KMS Autokey configuration for folders. The `--project` and `--folder`
  flags are now optional, defaulting to the current project.
* Added `--hsm-trusted-wrapping` flag to `gcloud kms keys create` and `gcloud kms keys versions import` to enable trusted wrapping capabilities.
* Promoted `gcloud kms keys versions export-trusted-key-wrapped` and `gcloud kms keys versions import-trusted-key-wrapped` to GA.
* Added `--crypto-key-version-name` and `--two-factor-public-key-pem` flags to `gcloud kms single-tenant-hsm proposal create` for `--operation-type=upgrade_key_trust`.

summary.title: KMS Autokey and HSM Updates
summary.summary: New features for Cloud Key Management Service include folder-level autokey configuration, trusted wrapping for key import/export, and enhanced options for single-tenant HSM key upgrades.

2026-07-14.content: * Added util function to validate and remove byte units from broker disk input.

summary.title: Manage Kafka Disks Easily
summary.summary: A new utility function simplifies disk management for your Kafka brokers. It validates and removes byte units from disk input, streamlining operations and reducing potential errors.

2026-07-14.content: * Modified `gcloud run services proxy` to fail immediately if the service has its default URL disabled.

summary.title: Cloud Run service proxy update
summary.summary: The `gcloud run services proxy` command now fails immediately if a service's default URL is disabled. This change improves the user experience by providing faster feedback in such scenarios.

2026-07-14.content:
* Upgraded `--storage-auto-increase-limit` flag for
  `gcloud sql instances create` and `gcloud sql instances patch`
  commands to GA.

summary.title: Storage auto-increase now generally available
summary.summary: The --storage-auto-increase-limit flag for Cloud SQL instances is now generally available. This feature automatically increases your instance's storage when it's running low. You can use this flag with the create and patch commands for Cloud SQL instances.

2026-07-14.content: * Updated `gcloud storage` [Parallel Composite Uploads](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/parallel-composite-uploads) to atomically clean up temporary parts, avoiding bucket soft-delete costs.

summary.title: Cloud Storage: Improved Composite Uploads
summary.summary: Cloud Storage now atomically cleans up temporary parts for parallel composite uploads. This update helps avoid unnecessary costs associated with bucket soft-delete.

2026-07-14.content: * Added support for Lustre dynamic tier in `gcloud cluster-director clusters` commands.

summary.title: Lustre dynamic tier support
summary.summary: Cluster Director now supports Lustre dynamic tiering. This enhancement is available through the `gcloud cluster-director clusters` commands, allowing for more flexible storage management within your clusters.

2026-07-14.content: * Updated `gcloud compliance-manager` commands to support project-level resources.

summary.title: Compliance Manager Updates
summary.summary: The Compliance Manager has been updated to support project-level resources. This enhancement allows for more granular control and management of compliance settings within your projects.

2026-07-14.content:
* Promoted `--nat-ips-per-endpoint` flag to GA in `gcloud compute service-attachments create` and `gcloud compute service-attachments update`.
* Promoted `gcloud compute hosts` and `gcloud compute reservations hosts` to beta.
* Added `gcloud compute sole-tenancy node-templates test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on a node template in beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `gcloud compute instant-snapshots set-iam-policy` command to support setting IAM policy bindings for instant snapshots in alpha, beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `gcloud compute network-attachments test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on a network attachment in beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `gcloud beta compute instance-groups managed adopt-instances` to support adopting instances into regional managed instance groups.
* Added `gcloud compute instant-snapshots test-iam-permissions` command to test
  IAM permissions on an instant snapshot in beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `get-iam-policy` and `set-iam-policy` commands to `gcloud compute firewall-policies` and `gcloud compute network-firewall-policies` to manage policy-level IAM policy.
* Promote the `--location` flag of `gcloud compute interconnects update` to GA.
* Added `gcloud compute backend-buckets test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on backend buckets.
* Promoted `--on-repair-allow-changing-zone` flag to GA in `gcloud compute instance-groups managed create` and `gcloud compute instance-groups managed update`.
* Added `gcloud compute interconnects test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine interconnect in beta.
* Added `gcloud compute instant-snapshot-groups test-iam-permissions` command.
* Added `test-iam-permissions` command to `gcloud compute target-tcp-proxies`
  to test IAM permissions on a target TCP proxy. Global proxies are
  supported in all tracks, and regional proxies are supported in alpha and
  beta tracks.
* Added support for displaying dynamic field `GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMESTAMP` to `gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-instances` in GA, beta and alpha.
* Added `gcloud compute service-attachments set-iam-policy` command to set IAM policy on a service attachment in beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `--async` flag to `gcloud compute instance-groups managed delete`.
* Promoted `--load-balancing-scheme` flag to GA in `gcloud compute target-tcp-proxies create`.
* Promoted `--instances` flag of `gcloud create instance-groups managed resize-requests create` to GA to support specific instance names.
* Added `gcloud compute reservations sub-blocks test-iam-permissions` command to beta, preview and GA release tracks.
* Added `on-update-action` enum class to `--create-disk` flag for an instance creation. And it is added to the following release tracks alpha, beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `gcloud compute external-vpn-gateways test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on an external VPN gateway.
* Added `gcloud compute sole-tenancy node-groups test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on a node group in alpha, beta, GA, and preview.
* Promoted `--identity`, `--identity-certificate` and `--most-disruptive-allowed-action` flags to GA.
* Added `gcloud compute disks bulk set-labels` command to alpha, beta, ga, and preview release tracks.

summary.title: Compute Engine gcloud updates
summary.summary: New features and GA promotions for Compute Engine gcloud commands, including enhanced IAM permissions testing, service attachment management, and instance group operations. This release also introduces support for adopting instances into managed instance groups and managing disk labels in bulk.

2026-07-14.content: * Promoted `gcloud developer-connect insights-configs deployment-events list` and `describe` commands to GA.

summary.title: Deployment Event Insights Now Generally Available
summary.summary: We are excited to announce that the `gcloud developer-connect insights-configs deployment-events list` and `describe` commands have been promoted to General Availability. This milestone brings robust insights into your deployment events directly to your fingertips.

2026-07-14.content:
* Added `KCP_VPA` option to `--logging` flag of `gcloud container clusters create` to enable VPA Decision Logs feature.
* Added `KCP_VPA` option to `--logging` flag of `gcloud container clusters create-auto` to enable VPA Decision Logs feature.
* Added `KCP_VPA` option to `--logging` flag of `gcloud container clusters update` to enable VPA Decision Logs feature.
* Added node config options `nodeVfioConfig` to
  `gcloud container clusters create`, `gcloud container node-pools create`, and
  `gcloud container node-pools update` command which contains VFIO-related
  configurations for this node.
* Added node config options `diskIoScheduler` to
  `gcloud container clusters create`, `gcloud container node-pools create`, and
  `gcloud container node-pools update` command which contains the configuration
  for the disk IO scheduler.
* Promoted Rollbackable Upgrades (Two-Step Upgrades) to GA. Added
  `--control-plane-soak-duration` flag to `gcloud container clusters upgrade`
  and promoted `gcloud container clusters complete-control-plane-upgrade` to GA.
* Promoted `--managed-otel-scope` flag to GA in `gcloud container clusters create` to enable Managed OpenTelemetry feature.
* Promoted `--managed-otel-scope` flag to GA in `gcloud container clusters create-auto` to enable Managed OpenTelemetry feature.
* Promoted `--managed-otel-scope` flag to GA in `gcloud container clusters update` to enable Managed OpenTelemetry feature.
* Additional kubectl versions:
  + kubectl.1.30 (1.30.14)
  + kubectl.1.31 (1.31.14)
  + kubectl.1.32 (1.32.13)
  + kubectl.1.33 (1.33.13)
  + kubectl.1.34 (1.34.9)
  + kubectl.1.35 (1.35.6)
  + kubectl.1.36 (1.36.2)

summary.title: Kubernetes Engine Updates
summary.summary: New features for Kubernetes Engine include VPA Decision Logs, node configuration options for VFIO and disk IO scheduling, and the General Availability of Rollbackable Upgrades. We've also promoted the Managed OpenTelemetry feature to GA and added support for several new kubectl versions.

2026-07-14.content:
* Promoted `--release-channel` and `--accelerated-security-patch-enabled` flags to GA for `gcloud looker instances create` and `gcloud looker instances update`.
* Added `RELEASE_CHANNEL` and `ACCELERATED_SECURITY_PATCH_ENABLED` columns to `gcloud looker instances describe` output in GA track.

summary.title: Looker Instance Flags Now Generally Available
summary.summary: Key flags for managing Looker instances, including release channels and accelerated security patches, have moved to General Availability for creation and update commands. The describe command now also reflects these settings in its output.

2026-07-14.content: * Added support for project-level security profiles to `gcloud network-security security-profiles wildfire-analysis` commands in BETA.

summary.title: Project-level security profiles in beta
summary.summary: You can now manage security profiles at the project level using `gcloud network-security security-profiles wildfire-analysis` commands, now available in beta. This enhancement allows for broader application of security policies across your projects.

2026-07-14.content: * Deprecated `--s3-compatible-mode` flag in `gcloud transfer agents install`. It is no longer needed as Transfer Service automatically detects S3-compatible job.

summary.title: Transfer Service S3 Compatibility Update
summary.summary: The `--s3-compatible-mode` flag for `gcloud transfer agents install` has been deprecated. Transfer Service now automatically detects S3-compatible jobs, making the flag unnecessary.

2026-07-14.content:
* Updated `gcloud vmware private-clouds create` command to use full resource
  names for `--preferred-zone` and `--secondary-zone` flags when creating a
  stretched private cloud. This update ensures compliance with VPC Service
  Controls.

Subscribe to these release notes at <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce>.

summary.title: Vmware Engine stretched private cloud zone updates
summary.summary: The `gcloud vmware private-clouds create` command has been updated to use full resource names for zone flags when creating stretched private clouds. This change ensures compliance with VPC Service Controls.
